correctness.rationale: The Schur-complement projection determinant is det(A)/Q(u), hence conditional line directions are brightness-weighted by sqrt(Q(u)), not uniform. Homothetic (d-1)-ball volume yields P(L>t)=H^{-1} int sqrt(Q)(1-t^2Q/4)_+^((d-1)/2) d sigma. Local coordinates transverse to the S^(k-1) maximum-axis sphere give exactly a^2Q=1+sum beta_j z_j^2, the change z_j=sqrt(2eps/beta_j)y_j, a dominated beta-ball integral, exponent (2d-k-1)/2 and stated Gamma constant. The sphere case reduces identically to (2eps-eps^2)^((d-1)/2). An independent 3D oblate quadrature for two axis triples gave ratios tending to 1. This numeric test is not the general proof.
